correctness.rationale: For k≥2 the canonical alternating top Laplacian has N=2k and L=N I-ss^T. Its centered columns split exactly into orthogonal N-scaled centered k-vertex regular simplices. Regular-simplex facet polarity gives r²=2k/(k-1) and R²=4k(k-1); group invariance and uniqueness give spherical John and Löwner ellipsoids and the unique incenter/Santaló center. Conical decomposition into k² congruent d-simplices gives covariance N/(N−1)I. Euclidean simplex volume, free-sum volume and polar-product volume give exact rational volumes and Mahler product; Stirling yields the ratio asymptotic. Smallest boundary k=2 is included. Exact fraction checks and SciPy hull/triangulation computations for k=2..5 corroborate every normalization; finite tests are not substituted for analytical proof. The result is explicitly scoped to canonical alternating orientation.

value.rationale: The natural family is the canonical even-dimensional cyclic-type top-Laplacian polytope singled out by the 2023 source; its intrinsic metric and Santaló geometry are not specified by lattice volume or combinatorial classification. The exact all-dimensional Mahler ratio grows as (e/(2sqrt(pi)))sqrt(k) relative to equal-dimensional simplices, while the volume covariance is exactly isotropic even for noncentrally symmetric k≥3. The complete sharp John/Löwner and tangent-facet evaluation is a motivated exact structural invariant profile. This does not claim a general extremal theorem, and uses standard free-sum identities transparently.
